original: 以道佐人主者，**不以兵强天下**。
vernacular_zh: 以道辅佐君主的人，不靠武力逞强于天下。
translation_en: He who would assist a lord of men in harmony with the Tao will not assert his mastery in the kingdom by force of arms.

scripture.text_zh: 有人靠车，有人靠马，但我们要提到耶和华我们神的名。
scripture.text_en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

insight_zh: 老子：以道佐政，**不靠兵力逞强**；诗篇：不靠战车战马，**唯靠耶和华**。
insight_en: Laozi: govern by the Tao, **not by force of arms**. Psalms: not chariots or horses, **but the LORD**.
